subject: POC alignment: success criteria, timelines & exec readout
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@zenova.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@zenova.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC alignment: success criteria, timelines & exec readout

Asha / Rajiv —

Great talking earlier — thanks for the time and for walking through Zenova's primary objectives. To keep momentum I captured the key pieces we discussed and proposed next steps below. Please confirm or flag corrections.

1) POC goal (what success looks like)
- Validate throughput: 500 concurrent requests with p95 latency < 450ms for 2k token prompts (real workload samples attached).
- Accuracy: end-to-end intent match >= 88% vs your golden set (50 labelled examples).
- Cost target: <= $0.015 / 1k tokens after standard batching and prefix caching.

2) Scope & assets we need from Zenova
- Shared sample prompts + 50 labelled golden examples (you said you'd share by Wed).
- VPN access for private connector test OR a staged S3 bucket with sanitized logs.

3) Timeline (proposed)
- Week 1 (Mar 15–19): access & data handoff, infra prep
- Week 2 (Mar 22–26): trial execution (load + quality runs)
- Week 3 (Mar 29–Apr 2): analysis + internal readout draft
- Apr 6: Executive readout + go/no-go decision (aim for 30–45 min)

4) Roles / ownership
- Redwood: Connor (POC lead / commercial), David (SE — infra & test plan), Lauren (customer success / onboarding).
- Zenova: Asha (product owner), Rajiv (platform lead), + CTO to attend final exec readout.

5) Deliverables
- Trial runbook and test harness (we attach our trial plan v2).
- Success criteria spreadsheet (attached) to be completed jointly by Thu.
- Final readout slide deck and recommendation.

Next actions:
- Asha: send golden examples + confirm preferred access method by EOD Thu (Mar 11).
- Connor: schedule exec readout tentatively for Tue Apr 6 at 11am PT; will send calendar invite once we confirm stakeholders.
- David: share the test plan and required IP/port whitelists.

Comments welcome — happy to tighten any of the targets if they feel off.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachment: redwood_trial_plan_v2.pdf (17 KB)
Attachment: zenova_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (12 KB)

From: Asha Patel <asha@zenova.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@zenova.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 12:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC alignment: success criteria, timelines & exec readout

Thanks Connor — this looks good overall and captures the call. A couple of quick notes from our side: 

- We'll share the 50 labelled examples by Wednesday (Mar 10). 
- For infra, we prefer the staged S3 approach (sanitized logs) rather than VPN for the initial trial — internal security will sign off faster. Rajiv will send the S3 bucket info and temporary creds.
- Can we push the exec readout one week later to Apr 13? Our CTO is booked the week of Apr 6. If we move to Apr 13 we can include a couple of PMs and the head of ops.

Also, two scope asks to confirm whether they would change success criteria: 
- Can we add an availability metric (>= 99.5% during test windows)?
- For accuracy, is intent match vs the golden set the canonical metric or do you also recommend a behavioral sampling audit?

I'll loop in our CTO (cto@zenova.ai) once we lock the date. Thanks again — excited to get started.

—Asha
Asha Patel | Head of Product, Zenova AI
asha@zenova.ai | +1 212-555-0104

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@zenova.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@zenova.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC alignment: success criteria, timelines & exec readout

Perfect — appreciate the quick responses and the S3 preference makes sense. Responses inline below: 

- Move exec readout to Tue Apr 13 at 11am PT (I've penciled but won't send invite until we have CTO + PM confirmation).
- Availability metric: yes — we can include 99.5% target during active test windows and will report it in the runbook.
- Accuracy metric: intent match vs golden set will be the canonical pass/fail gate for the trial; we will also do a behavioral sampling audit and include qualitative examples in the readout deck (recommended).

Action items updated: I will update the attached success criteria sheet and re-upload by EOD. David — can you confirm the test harness will include scheduled sampling for behavioral checks and the availability monitoring?

Connor

On a separate note, to keep procurement moving: after a successful POC the typical next step we've seen is a short-term commercial pilot order (1–3 months) followed by a committed Dedicated capacity agreement. We can outline those options in the readout deck so the execs have clear next steps.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@zenova.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@zenova.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC alignment: success criteria, timelines & exec readout

Connor / team —

Quick technical clarifications and what I'll deliver this week: 

1) Test harness
- Will run synthetic load (JMeter-based) and a replay of the golden set in parallel; includes availability pings at 30s cadence.
- Behavioral sampling: I'll add a scheduled job to pull 10 random responses per day for manual inspection.

2) Infra requirements (S3 flow)
- We'll need the sanitized S3 bucket + a short-lived IAM role (ARN) with read-only access. Please include a policy that excludes PII.
- Whitelisted egress for 52.1.110.0/24 and 18.205.30.0/24 during the run windows.

3) Deliverables by Thu Mar 11 EOD:
- Updated trial_plan_v2.pdf (with test harness steps) — attached.
- Completed success criteria sheet (zenova_poc_success_criteria.xlsx) — attached and highlighted changes.

I'll also record a short runbook walkthrough (2–3 min) and share a Drive link once uploaded.

-David
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — David, that matches what our security team expects. Rajiv will send the S3 access by EOD and I confirmed Apr 13 works for the exec readout (11am PT). I'll add our CTO to the invite once you send it.

Quick final asks before kickoff: 
- Connor: please include a section in the readout deck that outlines the two commercial paths (pilot vs Dedicated) and a rough time-to-contract estimate.
- Can you send a calendar invite (tentative) and a Calendly for the follow-up technical sync so our PM and ops leads can pick a slot?

I'll look out for the attachments and the invite.

—Asha
